output.reason: On its own, the cited list item [ev-2cad94fc463b] is just a metric name. Its section intro [ev-1f419676f177] supplies the rest. It says the listed `cortex_`-prefixed metrics change in 3.0.0 to start with `loki_` instead, so the subject is metric `cortex_prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered` and the change is a rename to `loki_prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered`.
